text:
GENERATE BURST X1-gen-01 — lane smoke (Run C-1). task_id "X1-gen-01".

Deliver EXACTLY TWO painted images, each a single isolated prop on a flat pure #00ff00 plate, in the register card's style and light (screen-upper-left key; painted, not pixel art; no floor shadow; no text):
1. out/x1_satchel.png — the hooded battle-mage's small worn-leather satchel (from Image 1), seen alone, roughly 300 px wide on a 1024 canvas, elevated three-quarter view.
2. out/x1_staff_head.png — the top 25 % of that same mage's bone-and-iron staff (from Image 1), seen alone, roughly 300 px tall on a 1024 canvas, same view.
Image 1 is a STYLE + IDENTITY reference (the register, brushwork and light); do NOT reproduce the figure — only the named prop. Use image_gen once per deliverable; at most ONE retry per deliverable if the first result is off-plate, has a baked checkerboard, or invents extra objects. Copy each final output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/ with the exact names above and compute its sha256.
No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "X1-gen-01"): list both images with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = the true number of image_gen calls; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: style + identity reference (the painted register, brushwork and upper-left key light); do not reproduce the figure
